# IMQOptions.publishFanOut property

Makes [ClusteredRedisQueue.publish()](/api/core/latest/core.clusteredredisqueue.publish/) write every event to every server of the cluster, as it did before 3.9.0, instead of to one.

**Signature:**

```typescript
publishFanOut?: boolean;
```

## Default Value

false

## Remarks

Only for a fleet whose subscribers do not each hold the whole cluster: a subscriber connected to one server alone (a single-host queue, or a cluster manager limited to part of the fleet) receives only what is published on that server. Fan-out costs every server the whole event stream, and delivers each event to a clustered subscriber once per server, so its handlers must deduplicate.
